runs.peer_review_resolution: Every retained pair received a second AI-assisted source/target comparison. Findings and resolutions are preserved in the peer records; this is not independent human specialist approval.
runs.source_book_order_policy: Resume Hebrews7:1 and follow the exact canon order and divisions. Prepare each complete book inventory only after every original of the previous book has been read, then read all originals in the current source book before advancing to the next. Carry unresolved deferrals separately without credit; later-book target/context readings do not open source review. The computed next_unreviewed is the exact continuation.

source_book_boundary.method: Resume Hebrews7:1 after101 previously read originals. Read all remaining originals of each current book before preparing and opening the next canonical source book. Target/context-only readings do not open source review; inventories and source-only readings earn zero completion credit. Final credit requires retained supported pairs and independent comparison.

runs.target_policy: User-specified hourly target: 500 newly completed distinct source verses with passage-supported cross-references. A source verse counts once irrespective of its number of retained target passages. Deferred and previously completed source verses earn zero new-source completion credit; pair totals are separate.
runs.review_scope: Initial AI-assisted supplied-English passage review. Source/target wording and numbering are pinned; independent specialist and live destination checks remain pending.
